decision_cruda.rationale: N522-01 stopped 5-8h, so LH-06 is idle. Activate Norte reserve RS-N548-02 (9.7 gpt, 350 t). Activation takes 1 h and travel 0.34 h, so loading starts about 11:20. That gives roughly 5 h at 40.8 t/h, about 200 t, or about 62 oz. Norte trucks (66 t/h) are not limited because inflow is 0. Central is truck-limited (inflow 152 vs 91 t/h), so I skipped its reserves. LH-10 is free at the workshop. Send it to TJ-E543-07 (8.3 gpt, 0.49 h away). Este has about 13 t/h of truck headroom, which is about 70-80 t, or about 20 oz. No home place loses production. I did not touch any development headings.
